app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $75 and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: For the current application season the application fee is $75.00. The $75.00 graduate application fee is non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers cover listed programs such as McNair and GEM; a department may pay the fee on merit, and Computer Science and Chemistry do not.
fee_waiver.quote: Waiver categories include those who have participated in the following programs:

also.quote: departments may be able to pay the application fee for you based on your academic merit

gre_general.value: The Graduate College sets no GRE rule; each program decides.
gre_general.quote: it is an admission requirement set by the graduate programs themselves

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 79 (100 for some programs), or 4 on the new 1-6 scale.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with no Speaking sub-score below 6.0, is the equivalent of TOEFL 79.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL ibt is 79 and this is equal to an IELTS (International English Language Testing System) score of 6.5 overall

english_waiver.value: India is not on the approved country list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: If you are an International applicant, proof of English proficiency is required, and waivers are only authorized under strict exceptions.

also.quote: Our list of approved countries includes Anguilla ... Zambia and Zimbabwe

notes: Duolingo is not accepted. The program pages set their own GRE, TOEFL and English rules where stated.
